draft.subject: Fwd: order entry at Kestrel
draft.body:
Hi Raj,

Noticed Kestrel Logistics is hiring an order entry administrator to key customer orders from emails into your system. That kind of re-keying tends to grow with every new customer.

We built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business.

Worth a look?

claims.text: Kestrel Logistics is hiring an order entry administrator to key customer orders from emails into your system
We built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business

evidence.text: Order Entry Administrator. Key duties: keying customer orders from emails and order forms into our system, checking stock and booking dispatch.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics GP is essential.

facts.wording: Built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business (Wish Wheels).
Built a citizen-services digital transformation platform with workflow automation and dashboards (MP Online Digital).
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.
